name: Plague Stone
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 3rd; Slot —; Price 200 gp; Weight 7 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This dark, wine-colored crystalline stone is approximately 6 inches in diameter and has a small metal loop mounted on the back, suitable for it to be hung by a rope or chain.

With a command word, the plague stone can light up as per continual flame with a bright ruby color which can be seen plainly even in daylight; the same word dismisses the continual flame It manifests a moderate divination aura, but has no divination properties.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells continual flame, magic aura; Cost 100 gp
